name: Floating offshore wind
applications: offshore oil and gas platform power
principle: Turbines on floating spar, semi-submersible or barge hulls moored in water deeper than 60 m. Equinor's Hywind Tampen has 11 turbines of 8.6 MW (94.6 MW) in 260 to 300 m of water and meets about 35% of the annual electricity demand of five Snorre and Gullfaks platforms.
